newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa to pool operations, marketing - source.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to pool operations, marketing - source.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG plans to merge its operations and marketing divisions in a reorganisation, a company source said on Wednesday.
The source said the management board had decided to set up a separate division for its scheduled passenger services with a six-member divisional management board.
But the reorganisation did not amount to a spin-off, the source said, responding to media reports that the airline plans to spin off its scheduled passenger services into a separate subsidiary.
Lufthansa would have to retain its legal status as a scheduled airline and that made a full spin-off of the division impossible.

Weekly newspaper Die Woche had reported that Lufthansa planned to set up a subsidiary for its scheduled business called Passage AG, which would be run by Fred Reid, the executive manager currently in charge of passenger services.
Die Woche made the article available ahead of publication in Thursday's editions.
